answer: SELECT s.Street, s.City, s.Zip, s.State FROM satscores sc JOIN schools s ON sc.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE sc.NumTstTakr > 0 AND sc.NumGE1500 IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CAST(sc.NumGE1500 AS REAL) / sc.NumTstTakr ASC, sc.cds ASC LIMIT 1;
SELECT s.School FROM schools s JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode WHERE s.DOC = '31' ORDER BY f.`Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 1;
SELECT GSoffered FROM schools WHERE Longitude IS NOT NULL AND GSoffered IS NOT NULL AND GSoffered != '' ORDER BY ABS(Longitude) DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.School, s.DOCType FROM frpm f JOIN schools s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND f.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL AND f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM frpm f2 JOIN schools s2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` IS NOT NULL AND f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY s.School;
SELECT f.`School Name` FROM frpm f JOIN satscores sc ON f.CDSCode = sc.cds WHERE (f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)`) > 0.1 AND sc.NumGE1500 >= 1;
SELECT County, COUNT(*) AS num_schools FROM schools WHERE County IN ('San Diego', 'Santa Barbara') AND Virtual = 'F' GROUP BY County ORDER BY num_schools DESC LIMIT 1;
